facts.fact: Gabonactu reports the Digital Economy ministry, with Smart Africa, SPIN and the Centre gabonais de l'innovation, officially launched the Smart Africa Youth Chapter Gabon on 2 May 2026, an online five-module programme with more than 2,000 young people already enrolled in phase one.
